channel.title: AI Builder's Field Guide — Recently Added
channel.description: A daily-curated wiki of the tools, models, and patterns that AI power-users and builders actually reach for.

item.title: OmniRoute
item.description: OmniRoute is a free AI gateway that provides a single endpoint to access over 231 AI model providers with token compression and auto-fallback. — It simplifies multi-model integration, optimizes inference costs through token savings, and enhances reliability by intelligently routing requests and handling failures.

item.title: Hyper
item.description: Hyper is a shared company brain that integrates internal information to enhance AI agents and automations by providing persistent, context-rich knowledge. — It addresses the critical challenge of context loss for AI agents, allowing them to retain company-specific information across sessions and improve performance on long-horizon tasks.

item.title: AgentVerse (OpenBMB)
item.description: AgentVerse is an open-source framework designed for deploying multiple LLM-based agents in task-solving and simulation applications. — It offers a structured approach for building and evaluating multi-agent systems, providing a comprehensive environment for complex AI workflows.

item.title: Logfire (Pydantic)
item.description: Logfire is an AI observability platform from Pydantic, capturing LLM calls, agent runs, and tool invocations with detailed metrics. — It provides comprehensive tracing and conversation panels for debugging, offering a unified platform to understand and improve LLM and agent application behavior.

item.title: Open Knowledge Format (OKF)
item.description: Open Knowledge Format (OKF) is an open, vendor-neutral specification from Google Cloud that formalizes organizational knowledge as markdown files with YAML frontmatter for AI agents and humans. — OKF provides a standardized, interoperable way for AI agents to access curated knowledge, unlike fragmented existing systems, and supports version-controlled, human-readable context.

item.title: Warp
item.description: Warp is a modern terminal that integrates AI to translate natural language into shell commands and execute multi-step tasks. — It enhances command-line workflows with AI, allowing engineers to interact with the terminal more naturally and automate complex operations.

item.title: Heron
item.description: An open-source passive network analyzer and AI agent auditor that uses eBPF to observe TLS-encrypted LLM calls and reconstruct agent activity. — It provides deep observability into AI agent behavior and LLM traffic at the network level, allowing debugging and verification without modifying agent code or introducing proxies.

item.title: Eve (Vercel)
item.description: Eve is an open-source TypeScript framework for building, deploying, and operating durable AI agents with a filesystem-first architecture. — It offers a streamlined, Vercel-native approach to agent development, simplifying deployment and integrating core capabilities through a file-based structure, distinguishing it from general-purpose frameworks.
